svg.title: After: me as the CEO of a team of project bots
svg.desc: The same terminal-style diagram and the same twelve threads. You at the top left now has a short job: set direction, judge results, give feedback, decide when we're done. What reaches me is critical decisions only, and I define critical. One clean wire runs from You to three persistent Grok Bot project managers, a news bot, a game bot and a desk bot, one per project. They prompt the agents, pick the machine, read every turn, merge, build and release. A dashed amber line labelled decisions runs back up to You. Below them, the T3 Fleet Gateway bar connects to the same two macOS machines and one Linux machine running T3 Code. The threads are now green or working: turn read, answered, merged, built, released, next step sent, and the iOS task is on a macOS machine.
svg.text: critical decisions only, and I define critical
PROJECT MANAGER · ONE GROK BOT PER PROJECT
they prompt the agents · pick the machine · read every turn · merge, build, release
FOUNDATION · T3 FLEET GATEWAY + T3 CODE
